searchText: All these are ready and the numbers are great! Specs: https://hackmd.io/@0xdeveloperuche/SkScRpTObe RETH + EXEX server over a custom TCP: https://hackmd.io/nz8dncoPRY6btL_uOQmWpQ#Lighthouse--RETH-using-EXEX-for-witness-indexing-served-over-TCP RETH + EXEX server over a custom TCP, using `sendfile` not `DB`: https://hackmd.io/nz8dncoPRY6btL_uOQmWpQ#Lighthouse--RETH-using-EXEX-for-witness-indexing-served-over-TCP-using-sendfile-rather-than-DB-reads Great work on this, it looks very promising! The key takeaway is that we can achieve a 2 orders-of-magnitude latency improvement by moving away from JSON-RPC. <@944007601400741989> what are your thoughts about custom TCP vs HTTP? I'm wondering if maybe the UX of having custom TCP would make it less adaptable / natural with pre-existing libraries frameworks or do you think thats not a problem? cc: <@427491045308235776> see above for latency improvmeents regarding migrating away from json-rpc for witness fetching. The UX for custom TCP is fairly different from the traditional HTTP, but not complicated… the Rust and Typescript implementation is very straightforward. Building on already existing libraries from ‘Tokio’ or ‘std’ for rust and ‘net’ for typescript the custom TCP implementation can be done with as little as 30 LOC Makes sense. Can you open a PR to implement this in the reth-wintess-indexer repo please? It would aslo be great if you can create a new crate for the TCP client so we can import that client in downstream repos and make requests against the node using it. Sure! Would do that. Hey <@402080271563751435>, please help review; https://github.com/scroll-tech/reth-witness-indexer/pull/15 Thanks I'll review tomorrow

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: Great work on this, it looks very promising! The key takeaway is that we can achieve a 2 orders-of-magnitude latency improvement by moving away from JSON-RPC.

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: <@944007601400741989> what are your thoughts about custom TCP vs HTTP? I'm wondering if maybe the UX of having custom TCP would make it less adaptable / natural with pre-existing libraries frameworks or do you think thats not a problem?

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: cc: <@427491045308235776> see above for latency improvmeents regarding migrating away from json-rpc for witness fetching.

excerpts.author: developeruche
excerpts.content:
The UX for custom TCP is fairly different from the traditional HTTP, but not complicated… the Rust and Typescript implementation is very straightforward.

Building on already existing libraries from ‘Tokio’ or ‘std’ for rust and ‘net’ for typescript the custom TCP implementation can be done with as little as 30 LOC

excerpts.author: taulepton_
excerpts.content: Makes sense. Can you open a PR to implement this in the reth-wintess-indexer repo please? It would aslo be great if you can create a new crate for the TCP client so we can import that client in downstream repos and make requests against the node using it.
